title: Simple Omelette Recipe
description: An easy and quick dish, perfect for any meal. This classic omelette combines beaten eggs cooked to perfection, optionally filled with your choice of cheese, vegetables, or meats.

content: Optional fillings: cheese, diced vegetables, cooked meats, herbs

content.title: Beat the eggs
content.value: In a bowl, beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper until they are well mixed. You can add a tablespoon of water or milk for a fluffier texture.

content.title: heat the pan
content.value: Place a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add butter or oil.

content.title: Cook the omelette
content.value: Once the butter is melted and bubbling, pour in the eggs. Tilt the pan to ensure the eggs evenly coat the surface.

content.title: Add fillings (optional)
content.value: When the eggs begin to set at the edges but are still slightly runny in the middle, sprinkle your chosen fillings over one half of the omelette.

content.title: Fold and serve
content.value: As the omelette continues to cook, carefully lift one edge and fold it over the fillings. Let it cook for another minute, then slide it onto a plate.

content.title: Enjoy
content.value: Serve hot, with additional salt and pepper if needed.

title: Classic Salad Recipe
description: A simple salad that combines mixed greens, vegetables, cheese, and a homemade vinaigrette dressing.

content.title: Prepare the ingredients
content.value: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, carrots, cheese, and parsley.

content.title: Make the vinaigrette
content.value: In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, salt and pepper until well combined.

content.title: Assemble the salad
content.value: Pour the vinaigrette over the ingredients and toss to combine.

title: Classic Grilled Cheese Recipe
description: A simple grilled cheese sandwich recipe that combines melted cheese between two slices of bread.

content.title: Prepare the ingredients
content.value: In a small Bowl, combine the butter or oil and the cheese slices.

content.title: Assemble the sandwich
content.value: Place one slice of bread in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the cheese slices on top of the bread.

content.title: Cook the sandwich
content.value: Once the cheese begins to melt, place the second slice of bread on top of the sandwich. Flip the sandwich over and cook for another 2 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is fully melted.
